Terrible service. I made an appointment for Saturday, March 28th at 10:00 AM, they confirmed it, I arrived on time, and we waited 30 minutes and they never opened the curtain or sent us any message. Terrible service!!!

Besides treating him so well, he came out looking beautiful, clean, and very happy. You can really tell when someone loves what they do. Thank you for making such a stressful experience for him so calm. I highly recommend them <333
Very good service.

A kind and caring experience for my dog, who came out happy after his hand stripping session. Highly recommended.

Excellent service and very friendly

She was literally locked in a cage the ENTIRE day, even though she's a large dog. A TERRIBLE EXPERIENCE. I dare say it's animal abuse what they do because they can't organize their schedules. I absolutely do not recommend this place, as all they offer is an "apology."
Excellent service, they left Kiwi in very good condition, very well cared for, at a good price.

Excellent service 😛 …

Just as Yllen mentioned in a comment below, my intention was to support the local service.
What's questionable is that they didn't notice the enormous wound, clearly from scissors. We, as owners, know the skin fold that forms when we hold our pet's fur. They advertise themselves as professionals, but their ethics are exposed here.
Excellent service, very friendly and they treat pets with great care; the experience with my dog ​​Lasky was very pleasant.

Excellent service and attention from Angel, we will definitely return.

Excellent service! Ángel is a wonderful person with so much love and experience with dogs. He gives great advice and makes them look absolutely gorgeous. Good prices and great service overall. I was amazed!
Benito always looks very handsome there

Excellent place and service.
I brought my dog, who is usually difficult to handle if they don't know how or take the time to calm him down. But here, both the atmosphere and Angel helped my dog ​​calm down and stay peaceful.
In the end, he was able to perform the entire service.
Excellent treatment of dogs, they are very kind, attentive and friendly and definitely the first choice because for them dogs come first.

It's truly sad to see how they don't deliver what you ask for. I took my two dogs to a VIP spa at 5 pm, and they told me they were running late, but they never told me how late. I arrived at 7 pm to pick up my dogs, and they hadn't even been bathed or anything. They only trimmed the dachshund's nails, and they did a terrible job, by the way, because his nails bled. It's a place I wouldn't recommend. I don't know if they don't understand the love we feel for our canine friends and that we want the best for them, but with places like this that tell you one thing and do whatever they want, it really makes you not want to support local businesses. And it's worth mentioning that they advertise one price, and they wanted to charge my Yorkie extra for grooming, even though the price they advertise on their social media says "small breed" this much, "medium breed" that much, and I booked the VIP spa package, which included everything. The reality of this place is sad... Anyway, I don't recommend it.
Good place, they're patient with dogs; my dogs aren't big fans of baths but they always come out calm.
Excellent service from the staff there, they take great care of my baby and he always comes home very happy with his haircut ✨🥰 Roma Norte branch …

Chicle is the happiest dog whenever he's with you! Thank you for treating him so well and always spoiling him.

I'm giving it 4 stars because of two minor issues. First, my dog ​​apparently got nervous and broke his leash while waiting for his bath. Second, I paid for a toothbrush and they didn't give it to me, due to both of our oversights and because we were talking about the leash.

I liked the service because it wasn't slow, my dog ​​looked great, and the food was delicious. I recommend it!

I loved the attention my dog ​​received. It was her first bath, and she came out very happy.

They answered all my questions.
Excellent service. Very professional, they treat the dogs very well, they're friendly, and they give you grooming recommendations for your dog based on your specific needs. 10 out of 10 🙂 …

I made an appointment but when I got there they said they were running behind 1-2 dogs are in front of my dog. They said it would be about  ~30 mins delay but can call/text me to come back. I didn’t get a call/text until about 1 hour later. I totally understand things happen but better to not overbook. I only walked into the facilities and they have dogs in kennels and some clearly anxious dogs. My dog is very nervous at the groomers and this environment would not be ideal for him. Since they contacted me an hour later I preferred to cancel. It was just disrespectful as I blocked time for this grooming. Luckily I did ended up finding another salon with no kennels and totally different environment it was all calm/zen. I’d avoid if you have a nervous dog or in a have a set schedule.
Gordita is a somewhat demanding and a little difficult customer, but here she is treated very well and always leaves very happy and smelling delicious 🤗 …

Excellent service! The staff was super friendly and made me feel at ease leaving my baby with them! 🩵 My puppy didn't come out sighing like he'd been crying or anything! Everything was great! 👍🏼 …
They made Kero look very nice, they treated him with love and he left happy.
I loved how my dogs turned out. Excellent service. Thank you so much.
My dog ​​Lola loves her bath at La Perrukeria.

It's been such a triumph finding a place where my furry friends are treated well, where both owner and pet receive excellent care, and LA PERRUKERIA outdid themselves. Ángel and Melanie were incredible; they understood my worries and anxieties about caring for my babies, as well as what I wanted for them. I'm 10/10 happy. I finally found the perfect place, thank you so much! 😘
